status: Design prepared; reusable sword disciple prefab is this session's first asset preparation. Wave controller is not implemented.
scope_first_batch: Two bounded desktop sword-disciple waves; preserve the existing duel lab as an independent manual-play scene.

new_classes.UNLWaveDefinition: WaveId, finite spawn entries with stable EntryId, enemy subclass, count and candidate spawn-point IDs; spawn interval, intermission, maximum alive and bounded failed-spawn retries.
new_classes.ANLEncounterController: Ready, Spawning, WaitingClear, Intermission, Completed, Failed and Cancelled states; StartEncounter, CancelEncounter, ResetEncounterForRetry and SetEncounterPaused. Emit terminal outcomes once.

prefab.requires_saved_configuration: A raw native spawn does not automatically inherit the current placed actors' saved grip/animation overrides. Use the configured Blueprint or explicitly configure before BeginPlay.

runtime_contracts: Own a SpawnOrdinal-to-weak-Actor/RuntimeId/terminal-record collection; never use attack-director reservations as wave completion counts.
Register identity and state callbacks before enabling combat; retain 0.35-second enemy spawn grace and cap successful spawns per frame.
Only finish a wave after all finite planned entries are handled, no spawn/loading request remains, and the wave-owned alive set is empty.

Listen to Brain.OnStateChanged(Enemy, Previous, New). Dead produces one defeated event; Despawn produces no reward. Navigation failures can despawn an enemy whose Vitals still reports alive, so handle finite replacement or Failed explicitly.

Use a monotonically increasing EncounterGeneration to reject cancelled callbacks. Cancel locks the encounter, stops generating, disables owned enemies, despawns and cleans them; release old Director reservations through existing enemy APIs.
Use world game time for spawn, intermission and corpse delays. Pause calls each owned enemy's SetLabPaused; resumed attacks obtain new warnings.

Use a dedicated FRandomStream and sorted stable spawn-point IDs. Save initial/current seed, wave index and spawn ordinal. Keep navigation, physics and cosmetic randomness outside the composition stream.

Route R through encounter cancellation first, then existing projectile/Director/Vitals/Blade/Resolver reset, then ResetEncounterForRetry(seed,false). G starts/cancels the encounter only when a controller is present. Keep fixed duel actors' original lab behavior.
following_dependency: SAVE-01 uses the entry snapshot and random state after WAVE-01 exists.
acceptance: Implementation compile and initial scene inspection can be done when implemented. Gameplay acceptance and any tests remain pending explicit user authorization.
